title: 7 tips to deliver stellar Facebook customer support | Freshworks Academy
description: Customers frequently discuss their grievances about businesses on Facebook. They also often go to Facebook to get recommendations from their friends and colleagues.  This makes Facebook a huge platform to tap into which makes it important to get something as public as customer support right.   Although it can take extra resources, time and money, a stellar customer support can really pay off in terms of customer satisfaction which in turn will help your business grow and prosper.   There are no sure-fire ways of getting it 100% right but measures can certainly be put in place to avoid putting your brand in perilous situations.   We have put together a few tips to help agents with the task of providing great Facebook customer support.   7 tips to handle Facebook customer support:  ▢ Read the comments  ▢ Make responses personal  ▢ Use Messenger  ▢ Respond quickly  ▢ Set expectations  ▢ Set up a Facebook support group  ▢ Anticipate issues and reach out proactively  Click here to see the blog post related to the video: https://freshdesk.com/customer-service-training/tips-facebook-support-blog/  Join the Freshworks Academy to see real-life examples of great customer support on Twitter - https://www.freshworks.com/academy/  Check out Freshworks, a refreshingly simple and intuitive customer engagement software : https://www.freshworks.com/

asr.full_text: What Can You Do With a Frequent Request on Facebook? Customers frequently discuss their grievances about businesses on Facebook. They also go to Facebook to get recommendations from their friends. This makes Facebook a HUGE Public Platform where you need to get customer services right. Hi! I'm Akshya from FreshBooks Academy and I am going to discuss ways to make your Facebook customer support better Before we talk about how to do that let's discuss the most essential thing a business needs to have on Facebook a Business Page A Facebook business page helps people learn about what your business is, how to contact you and where you're located. Your Facebook page will have a menu on the left side that allows your customers to view information such as your about leaving Facebook. After you set up your business page, whenever customers have grievances, they're more likely to talk to you instead of talking to each other. Now, let's get down to the tips that you can use to nail Facebook support. Read the comments. I know this is obvious, but it's really important to understand what customers are talking about you on Facebook once you have a Facebook page. Look for opportunities where you can offer assistance and follow conversation threads to understand how your customers are reacting to your new product or service. Make responses personal. Humans like to be social and make connections, so don't be afraid to show your personality while replying to comments. Make sure that you greet the customer with his or her name and also sign off conversations with your name. This lets you build a good rapport between you and the customer, and reminds them that there are people behind the brand. Use Messenger Messenger is a chat tool that exists on your Facebook page and is a great way for your customers to get in touch with your brand. Messenger allows you to automatically initiate conversations and send a custom greeting to anyone who messages your page. You can also use Messenger on your website or app by connecting them to your Facebook page. If you primarily use your page to support customers, your page button can also be connected to your Messenger. You can also use other apps like Minichat, that lets you send out automatic responses if certain keywords are found in your customer's message. This will help solve simpler problems without human intervention. But the important thing here is to make sure that customers are only 1 step away from human If they are not satisfied with the response, they can immediately talk to an agent. Respond quickly 60% of people who reach out to brands on Facebook expect a reply within an hour. One way to make sure you respond quicker is by assigning a dedicated support person for your Facebook page. Another way of doing this would be to use a customer support software like Freshdesk that let's you remove unwanted noise and tend to customers who need your help. 5. Set Expectations Your team cannot be available round-the-clock just so you can meet the one-hour response deadline. And customers don't expect to be available 24x7 either. They just need to know when they can expect a response. You can do this by scheduling your business' away time and set up an appropriate message to let the customer know when they can expect a response. This also stops Facebook's algorithms from penalizing you for not being responsive, when you're not available and helps you maintain your responsiveness rating. Set up a Facebook support group. You can have your customers help themselfs by setting up a group. This way instead of contacting you with simply problems, they they can just posted on the group and get help from other customers the tricky part is getting people to join the group the likelihood of people joining will increase with the value you're offering to them just like how you would with a Facebook page putting out relevant content which could be in the form of polls pictures videos or they're going life can really help you build your brand and also acquire new leads for your business. you can also use groups insights to find popular days and times to post based on engagement levels or learn more about your members. Anticipate issues and reach out proactively. Keep an eye on what the customers are saying about you and reach out to them proactively even before they need any help. This kind of approach involves getting a social media monitoring tool that monitors the mentions and keywords relating to your products and industry. Proactive support surprises and delights the customer- it shows that you genuinely care about them. Follow these 7 tips to create a unique Facebook Strategy to win customers over. What are the strategies that you use to effectively handle Facebook support? Let us know through the comments below. Thanks for watching, if you liked this video give us a thumbs up and subscribe to our channel. For more useful content, enroll in the Freshworks academy, the link is in the description. Until then, Buy! and Happy Supporting!
